**Practice only:** {{drill/scrimmage evidence links}}. **Competition evidence, if any:** {{separately linked Summer League, preseason or NBA reports}}.

Keep attempts and opportunities visible. A harder drill can produce a lower percentage without establishing deterioration. Recompute combined percentages from total makes/attempts, never by averaging session percentages. Do not pool different protocols or practice and game samples.
